req.title: Reject malformed player payload
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when POST /players/ receives a body that fails Player schema validation.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a 422 Unprocessable Entity status when a malformed player payload is sent to the POST /players/ endpoint. This behavior ensures that only valid data is processed and stored, maintaining data integrity. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct handling of valid data, a negative test to check the response to malformed data, and a boundary test to ensure the system correctly handles edge cases.

tests.name: Valid Player Payload
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The database is pre-loaded with fixture data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid player payload.
expected: The response contains the created player data with a UUID.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

valid_payload = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "squadNumber": 99,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_payload)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert "id" in response.json()

tests.name: Malformed Player Payload
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The database is pre-loaded with fixture data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a malformed player payload.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating validation failure.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

malformed_payload = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "squadNumber": "invalid_number",
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=malformed_payload)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "Unprocessable Entity" in response.text

tests.name: Boundary Test for Squad Number
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The database is pre-loaded with fixture data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a player payload where squadNumber is at the boundary of valid values.
expected: The response status code is 201 for valid boundary values.
The response status code is 422 for invalid boundary values.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Test with valid boundary value
valid_boundary_payload = {
    "firstName": "Boundary",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "squadNumber": 0,
    "position": "Forward"
}
response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_boundary_payload)
assert response.status_code == 201

# Test with invalid boundary value
invalid_boundary_payload = {
    "firstName": "Boundary",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "squadNumber": -1,
    "position": "Forward"
}
response = client.post("/players/", json=invalid_boundary_payload)
assert response.status_code == 422
